skill.name: planning-action
skill.description: Creates structured roadmaps, timelines, phased plans, and execution sequences from a goal or decision.
skill.summary: Turns goals into scoped execution plans with milestones, dependencies, risks, and contingencies.
skill.author: BellaBe

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in this prompt-only skill. Manual review found no prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, executable code, or other semantic security concerns.

content.value_statement: Vague goals are hard to convert into work. This skill turns a decision into phases, milestones, dependencies, risks, and checkpoints.
actual_capabilities: Restates goals and constraints before planning.
Defines scope and non-scope for the work.
Breaks work into phases with milestones.
Includes risks and contingencies in the output.
limitations: Does not create repeatable standard operating procedures.
Does not replace stakeholder approval or domain expertise.
Does not estimate budgets unless the user provides data.
Does not execute tasks or manage project tools.

use_cases.title: Plan a Product Rollout
use_cases.description: Create phases, milestones, dependencies, and risks for a product launch or feature release.

use_cases.title: Organize Team Execution
use_cases.description: Turn a team decision into a clear sequence of work with scope and checkpoints.

use_cases.title: Structure Personal Projects
use_cases.description: Convert a personal goal into manageable phases with constraints, risks, and next milestones.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a phased plan for [goal]. Include goal, constraints, scope, milestones, dependencies, and risks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for a simple goal that needs an execution path.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this decision into a rollout plan: [decision]. Use phases, checkpoints, dependencies, and contingency steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when a decision needs a launch or adoption sequence.

prompt_templates.title: Sequence a Project Timeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an execution sequence for [project] with target dates, non-scope, milestones, risks, and validation checkpoints.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when timing, order, and dependencies matter.

prompt_templates.title: Pressure-Test a Complex Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a phased plan for [goal] under these constraints: [constraints]. Show dependencies, risks, contingencies, and decision checkpoints.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for complex work with constraints or multiple stakeholders.

output_examples.input: Launch a customer feedback program next quarter.
output: Goal and constraints: Launch a repeatable feedback process within one quarter.
Scope: Survey design, customer outreach, intake process, review cadence, and reporting.
Phased plan: Prepare research goals, pilot with a small segment, expand collection, then review outcomes.
Risks: Low response rates, unclear ownership, and delayed analysis.

output_examples.input: Move support documentation into a new help center.
output: Scope: Audit existing content, define migration rules, prepare redirects, and publish the new center.
Non-scope: Rewriting every article unless it blocks migration quality.
Dependencies: Platform access, analytics baseline, content ownership, and support team review.
Checkpoint: Validate search, navigation, and top article accuracy before launch.

output_examples.input: Create a six-week plan for a hiring process update.
output: Phase 1: Confirm goals, constraints, stakeholders, and legal review needs.
Phase 2: Draft the process, scorecards, and interviewer guidance.
Phase 3: Pilot the update with one role and collect feedback.
Contingency: Extend the pilot if interviewers report inconsistent scoring.

best_practices: Provide the goal, constraints, deadline, stakeholders, and known dependencies.
Ask for explicit scope and non-scope when the work could expand.
Review risks and checkpoints before using the plan with a team.
anti_patterns: Do not use it for open-ended advice without a committed goal.
Do not use it as a substitute for a detailed standard operating procedure.
Do not expect accurate dates or budgets without source data.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates phased execution plans with goals, constraints, scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, and contingencies.

faq.question: Can it build a project timeline?
faq.answer: Yes. It can organize work into phases and milestones when you provide timing constraints.

faq.question: Does it manage tasks automatically?
faq.answer: No. It produces planning guidance but does not update project management tools.

faq.question: When should I not use it?
faq.answer: Do not use it for general advice without a committed goal or for repeatable procedures.

faq.question: What input improves the result?
faq.answer: Provide the goal, deadline, constraints, stakeholders, available resources, and known risks.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
